proposition: The R. Ḥurūf is dated 10 Ramaḍān 817/23 November 1414 yet is said to mention the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam, dated Dhū l-Ḥijja 817/March 1415, which is later; Melvin-Koushki does not reconcile the two dates (a mention of a work in progress, or an error in one date, would each remove the tension, but the entry says neither).
